scope: Day-10 P0-A native readiness cancellation/expiry races and final-frame capture provenance

regression.red: A native semantic callback revoked the owning observer while returning ready. The existing coordinator returned READY instead of owner_revoked; native test aborted on the assertion.
regression.other_cases: Cancellation raised inside the callback and callback completion after absolute deadline are also tested. An old test's last-frame expectation was corrected to require the last accepted authorized frame.

fixes: ReadinessCoordinator rechecks cancel, ownership and deadline after semantic sampling and before accepting a READY predicate or marking the sample as accepted.

Swift native observe_reader binds metadata-only capture receipts to each sampled frame identity and chooses the receipt belonging to the coordinator's actual final frame rather than the most recent capture.
Only bounded metadata for at most sixteen captures is retained; any missing or mismatched native capture identity fails closed. No new capture or image relay is issued.

verification.command: cmake --build native/build --target swift_observer_readiness_tests swift_observer_reader_tests swift_observer_engine_tests swift_observer_frame_tests swift_observer_ocr_tests --parallel 2

limits: Readiness was tested with deterministic owned C++ frames and native CTest binaries, not live foreground Swift observer or authenticated GPT Web model. The final capture metadata selection is compiled into swift_core and structurally reviewed; real returned capture/ROI matching is still E2E-unverified. No existing denied desktop_observe operation was replayed.
